'''Alexander Szameit''' (born 10 January 1979) is a German physicist working in experimental solid-state optics.<ref name="CPR">{{Cite web|url=http://cpr.uni-rostock.de//resolve/id/cpr_person_00003647|title=Szameit, Alexander - JSPDocportal Sample|first=Universitätsbibliothek|last=Rostock|website=cpr.uni-rostock.de}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Szameit studied physics at the [[Martin Luther University of Halle-Wittenberg]] and the [[University of Jena]], graduating in 2004.<ref name="CPR" /> Following that, from 2004 to 2007 he pursued a doctoral degree at the University of Jena, graduating with the highest honor of "[[summa cum laude]]".<ref name="Krupp">{{Cite web|url=https://www.krupp-stiftung.de/presse/alexander-szamit-erhaelt-alfried-krupp-foerderpreis-fuer-junge-hochschullehrer-2017/|title=Alexander Szameit erhält Alfried Krupp-Förderpreis für junge Hochschullehrer 2017|website=Alfried Krupp von Bohlen und Halbach-Stiftung}}</ref> From 2009 he worked at the [[Technion]] in [[Haifa]] as a [[postdoctoral researcher]] in the group of [[Mordechai Segev]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://phsites.technion.ac.il/msegev/students/|title=Students, Post-docs and Group Alumni}}</ref> In 2011 he returned to the University of Jena as a [[junior professor]] and acquired his habilitation in 2015.<ref name="FSUjunprof">{{Cite web|url=https://www.physik.uni-jena.de/en/research/junior-scientists/habilitation/2015-completed-habilitation-procedures/jun-prof-dr-alexander-szameit|title=Habilitation announcement of FSU Jena}}</ref> Since 2016, he is a professor at the [[University of Rostock]], where he leads the Experimental Solid-state Optics group.<ref name="CPR" /> Since 2022, Szameit also serves on the board of the [[German Research Foundation]]'s collaborative research center 1477 "LiMatI"<ref name="LiMatI">{{Cite web|url=https://www.limati.uni-rostock.de/en/team/ |title=Homepage of the CRC 1477 Light-Matter Interactions at Interfaces}}</ref>

== Research==
Szameit's work focuses on the investigation of optical wave phenomena in discrete systems.<ref name = "GroupWebsite">{{Cite web|url=https://www.optics.physik.uni-rostock.de/|title=Startseite - Experimentelle Festkörperoptik - Universität Rostock|website=www.optics.physik.uni-rostock.de}}</ref><ref name = "SzameitNolte2010">{{cite journal |last1= Szameit |first1=Alexander |last2=Nolte |article-number= 163001 |doi=10.1088/0953-4075/43/16/163001 |s2cid=116947148 }}</ref> As experimental platforms, he utilizes artificial structured media such as arrays of coupled optical == Awards and honors ==
* 2009: Doctoral prize of the DPG ([[German Physical Society]])<ref>[https://www.dpg-physik.de/auszeichnungen/preise-der-dpg-vereinigungen/preistraeger-dissertationspreis-samop Awardees of the doctoral prize of the DPG], Deutsche Physikalische Gesellschaft</ref>
* 2014: [[Adolph Lomb Medal]] of the [[Optical Society]]<ref>[https://www.optica.org/en-us/get_involved/awards_and_honors/awards/award_descriptions/adolphlomb/ Adolph Lomb Medal], Optica</ref>
* 2015: Rudolf Kaiser award for experimental physics<ref>[https://www.dpg-physik.de/auszeichnungen/preise-der-dpg-vereinigungen/preistraeger-dissertationspreis-samop Rudolf Kaiser award for Szameit], Deutsches Stiftungszentrum</ref>
* 2017: Alfried Krupp prize of the Alfried Krupp von Bohlen und Halbach Foundation<ref name="Krupp" />
* 2020: [[Tomassoni award]]<ref>[https://www.phys.uniroma1.it/fisica/node/10215 Tomassoni Chisesi Prize] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211121010515/https://www.phys.uniroma1.it/fisica/node/10215 |date=2021-11-21 }}, Sapienza Università di Roma</ref>
* 2024: Elected as fellow of [[Optica (society)|Optica]]<ref>[https://www.optica.org/get_involved/awards_and_honors/fellow_members/elected_fellows/ Optica Elected Fellows], Optica</ref>

== Selected publications ==
* Rechtsman, Mikael C., Julia M. Zeuner, Yonatan Plotnik, Yaakov Lumer, Daniel Podolsky, Felix Dreisow, Stefan Nolte, Mordechai Segev, and Alexander Szameit. "Photonic Floquet topological insulators." Nature 496, no. 7444 (2013): 196–200.
* Weimann, Steffen, Manuel Kremer, Yonatan Plotnik, Yaakov Lumer, Stefan Nolte, Konstantinos G. Makris, Mordechai Segev, Mikael C. Rechtsman, and Alexander Szameit. "Topologically protected bound states in photonic parity–time-symmetric crystals." Nature materials 16, no. 4 (2017): 433–438.
* Tillmann, Max, Borivoje Dakić, René Heilmann, Stefan Nolte, Alexander Szameit, and Philip Walther. "Experimental boson sampling." Nature photonics 7, no. 7 (2013): 540–544.
* Zeuner, Julia M., Mikael C. Rechtsman, Yonatan Plotnik, Yaakov Lumer, Stefan Nolte, Mark S. Rudner, Mordechai Segev, and Alexander Szameit. "Observation of a topological transition in the bulk of a non-Hermitian system." Physical review letters 115, no. 4 (2015): 040402.
* Szameit, Alexander, and Stefan Nolte. "Discrete optics in femtosecond-laser-written photonic structures." Journal of Physics B: Atomic, Molecular and Optical Physics 43, no. 16 (2010): 163001.
